Bug fix release improving how CodexMeter opens Codex.

## Highlights

- Added support for opening Codex through the `codex://` URL scheme.
- This avoids a misleading macOS Privacy & Security notification that could claim CodexMeter was prevented from modifying other apps, even though CodexMeter does not modify apps.
- Kept fallback behavior for resolving the Codex app by bundle identifier or `/Applications/Codex.app`.
- Added tests for the new launcher order and fallback paths.
